_authority: NOT AUTHORITATIVE AT RUNTIME. The effective HNSW and map-size values are the generated Rust literals in `fn config()` at native/helix-repo/helix-python/src/queries.rs, which HelixEngine::new reads directly (native/helix-repo/helix-python/src/lib.rs). No Engram runtime reads this file -- NativeTransport.initialize() passes no config path at all. Editing a value HERE ALONE CHANGES NOTHING. To change one for real: edit `fn config()` in queries.rs, mirror the value into all three copies of this file, and run `make build-native`. server/tests/test_native_config_authority.py FAILS when this file and queries.rs disagree.
